WHAT IS ALREADY PRE-REGISTERED and is NOT reopened by this decision (STATISTICAL_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md sections 4b-4c): decision_cluster_id enters as a FIXED factor at every admissible G and NO cluster random-intercept variance is ever estimated from so few clusters; the pre-registered clusters are treated as an exhaustively enumerated fixed set rather than a sample from a population of clusters; condition and reset and their interaction remain the inferential target and are identified WITHIN clusters because every scored task is run under every condition; opportunities and repeated runs remain nested observations inside the three known clusters and are never entered as independent architecture decisions; and inference must never be reported as if G were large. WHAT REMAINS OPEN, with the permitted options enumerated so the choice cannot drift: (1) the repeated-measures structure for task and run given the realised counts - permitted options are (1a) task as a fixed block nested within cluster, (1b) task as a random intercept ONLY if the realised number of scored tasks and the fitted variance make it identifiable, or (1c) a cell-level dispersion/observation-level term - chosen by pre-registered criteria at pilot, never by which option gives the larger effect; (2) whether the cluster-robust sensitivity is CR2 or CR3 with Satterthwaite-style degrees of freedom, conditional on the implementation supporting it reliably at the realised G, with the honest fallback that at three clusters cluster-robust degrees of freedom are themselves unreliable and at G=2 they are unusable, in which case the within-block randomisation/permutation inference carries the sensitivity instead and the cluster-robust re-fit is omitted or reported as explicitly unreliable rather than promoted to primary evidence; (3) whether the cluster x condition heterogeneity check is reportable at the realised cell sizes, noting that at G=2 it carries only ONE between-cluster contrast and must be interpreted as such. NOTHING data-dependent may be run before this is resolved, and it must be resolved BEFORE the TD-B37 power simulation. No model was fitted, no data exist and no power value is frozen
